newsitem.title: CHINA: China premier to visit Moscow this month.
newsitem.headline: China premier to visit Moscow this month.

text.p: Chinese Premier Li Peng will visit Russia this month as part of regular, senior-level contacts between the two countries, the foreign ministry said on Thursday.
"Premier Li Peng's working visit to Moscow will signify the regular meetings of the premiers of the two countries," Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang told reporters.
Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin was expected to visit China next spring, shortly before Chinese President Jiang Zemin travels to Moscow, Russian embassy officials said.

Shen said that during Li's December 26-28 trip, the two sides would assess prospects for further economic cooperation but he declined to say whether any of several major projects that have long been under discussion would be made final.
Russian embassy officials said Moscow had been hoping for a final accord on plans for nuclear cooperation.
China has agreed in principle to buy Russian nuclear reactors but Russian officials in Beijing say the two sides are still far apart on the price.
Moscow has offered Beijing a 15-year, $2 billion low-interest loan to finance nuclear reactor construction.
China recently said it would switch the site of a plant using Russian nuclear technology to an eastern province from the originally planned northeast.
It denied that the change was due to financial problems besetting local authorities who were supposed to meet some of the cost.
The two countries have also announced plans to bring Siberian natural gas and oil to China but that project required further negotiation, Russian officials said.
